visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an animated scene of an indoor room with light tan walls. In the background, a framed window or door shows a blue-grey rainy exterior. On the floor, a blue umbrella lies closed on a puddle, with several blue cat paw prints leading into the frame. (2) A cartoon cat with white and yellow fur, wearing a small black and red cap, appears in the foreground. The cat is visibly soaking wet, with animated blue droplets dripping from its fur, and it looks directly at the viewer with a sad expression. (3) Large black text appears at the top center of the screen, followed by an English translation. A large grey number '2' then appears in the middle of the frame above the cat. (4) An icon of a pink hair dryer appears at the top, accompanied by a horizontal progress bar. Animated blue wind swirls blow around the cat, causing its fur to vibrate and gradually puff out while the cat closes its eyes. (5) Another prompt of black text appears, asking the viewer to blow again. A large grey number '3' follows, replacing the previous countdown. (6) The hair dryer icon and blue wind swirls reappear with higher intensity. The cat's fur expands dramatically until the cat resembles a perfectly round, fluffy sphere. The cat's eyes are wide and shocked. (7) The spherical, fluffy cat bounces once on the spot, then suddenly leaps or is blown off the left side of the screen, leaving an empty room.
